name: Samantha Rose
source: Olivia's oldest daughter, Samantha, has always been kind and sweet to me. She is a sophomore from Leonheart's house at Cordale. Samantha is a very talented wizard and the pride of the whole academy. She has a great future in the magical world and dreams of becoming the champion of the most prestigious wizarding tournament.
